verdict.rationale: Requesty's docs describe spend caps, service accounts, and MCP server management as concepts, but there is no evidence of an admin/management API for programmatically provisioning gateways, keys, or budgets — these appear to be dashboard-configured (docs-18, docs-19, docs-20). The openapi probe explicitly found no API spec at any candidate path (404s across openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.), suggesting no discoverable admin API surface.
